verdict.rationale: dlt itself is a data-loading library, not an analytics/insight-generation tool, but the dltHub AI Harness includes an agent skill that reads an analysis plan and auto-generates marimo notebooks with charts/ibis queries, which is a thin form of AI-assisted data insight generation on top of loaded data. This is a narrow, lightly-documented add-on rather than a core, in-product insight/suggestion engine. Missing for 10: detailed documentation or examples of actual generated insights/suggestions, independent corroboration, and any evidence of proactive suggestion generation beyond a single skill description.
